zh: 唯命是从的；顺从的；驯服的；听话的
en: in a way that shows you are willing to accept somebody else's authority and willing to obey them without questioning anything they want you to do
ex: ‘You're right and I was wrong,’ he said submissively.
“你说得对，是我错了。” 他恭顺地说。

zh: 唯命是从的；顺从的；驯服的；听话的
en: the fact of being too willing to accept somebody else's authority and willing to obey them without questioning anything they want you to do

zh: 顺从；屈服；投降；不得已接受
en: to give a document, proposal, etc. to somebody in authority so that they can study or consider it
ex: to submit an application/a claim/a proposal
提交申请/索赔/建议

zh: 低于正常的；正常值以下的；偏低的
en: lower than normal
ex: subnormal temperatures
偏低的气温

zh: 次优的；未达最佳标准（或质量）的；非最理想的
en: of less than the best standard or quality
ex: Some breeders keep their animals in suboptimal conditions.
有些畜牧户在差强人意的环境下饲养牲畜。

zh: 以次佳方式；低于最高标准地
en: not in the best way; not to the highest standard
having less power or authority than somebody else in a group or an organization
ex: In some societies women are still subordinate to men.
在某些社会中，妇女仍然服从于男人。

en: a group of words that is not a sentence but adds information to the main part of a sentence, for example when it rang in She answered the phone when it rang.

zh: 从属连词；主从连词；从属连接词
en: a word that begins a subordinate clause, for example ‘although’ or ‘because’

zh: 把…置于次要地位；使从属于
en: the act of treating somebody/something as less important than somebody/something else
ex: the subordination of women
妇女的从属

zh: 收买，买通（使作伪证等）；唆使（他人犯法）
en: to pay or persuade somebody to do something illegal, especially to tell lies in court
ex: to suborn a witness
收买证人

zh: 不到一般（或预期）水平的；低于标准的
en: below a level of quality that is usual or expected
ex: a subpar performance
低水平的演出

zh: （戏剧、小说等的）次要情节，从属情节
en: a series of events in a play, novel, etc. that is separate from but linked to the main story
a written order to attend court as a witness to give evidence
ex: He was served with a subpoena.
他被传唤出庭作证。

zh: 子例程（程序中执行某任务的一系列指令）
en: a set of instructions which perform a task within a program

zh: 订阅（电子信息服务或其他互联网服务）
定期交纳（会员费）；定期（向慈善机构）捐款；定期捐助
en: to pay an amount of money regularly in order to receive or use something
ex: Which journals does the library subscribe to?
图书馆订有哪些报刊？

en: to agree with or support an opinion, a theory, etc.
ex: The authorities no longer subscribe to the view that disabled people are unsuitable as teachers.
当局不再支持残疾人不适宜做教师的观点。
